prompt: State the definition of work done by a force.
answer: Product of force and displacement in the direction of the force.

mark_scheme.criterion: product of force and displacement (or distance moved) in the direction of the force

hints: Recall the exact Cambridge syllabus definition.
Do not forget to specify the direction.
solution: Work done is defined as the product of force and displacement in the direction of the force.
teacher_walkthrough: Award B1 only if 'in the direction of the force' or 'in line of action of force' is included.

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original drill on the standard definition of work done.
